SPECIAL TERMS & CONDITIONS : 1.SUPPLIER SHALL PROVIDE TRAINING FOR OPERATORS/TECHNICIANS. 2.SUPPLIER SHALL PROVIDE 2 SET OF PARTS,OPERATION,SERVICE MANUAL,1 SET TOOL KIT WITH EACH PA YLOADER. 3.SUPPLIER SHALL DEPUTE THEIR SERVICE ENGINEER FOR COMMISSIONING OF THE MACHINE AT OUR SITE FREE OF COST. 4.INITIAL 3 NOS OF SERVICINGS TO BE DONE BY SUPPLIER ALONG WITH SUPPLY OF FILTERS(AIR,FUEL, LUB OIL,HYDRUALIC OIL & TRANS.OIL)AND LUBRICANTS (ENGINE AND LUB OIL,HYDRAULIC OIL & TRANS.OIL) AN D COOLANTS REQUIRED FOR FIRST THREE SERVICING FREE OF COST.THESE SPARES AND CONSUMABLES S HALL BE SUPPLIED ALONG WITH THE PAYLOADER. 5.SUPPLIER SHALL PROVIDE MANUFACTURER'S MONOGRAM ON THE BODY OF THE TYRE PAYLOADER. 6.MACHINE SHOULD BE FITTED WITH SOUND & DUST PROOF REAR MOUNTED AIR CONDITIONED CABIN ME ANS "CABIN TO BE MOUNTED ON THE REAR SIDE OF CHASSIS" . 7.MACHINE SHOULD BE FITTED WITH REVERSE BACK-UP LIGHT,ALARM AND REAR VIEW CAMERA. 8.SUPPLIER HAS TO SUBMIT ALL DOCUMENTS LIKE FORM 21 & 22, TRC REQUIRED FOR REGISTRATION OF T HE MACHINE AT R.T.O,ROURKELA.SUPPLIER SHALL ALSO PROVIDE HIGH SECURITY REGISTRATION PLATE(H SRP) WHICH IS MANDATORY . 9.SUPPLIER OTHER THAN INDIAN ORIGIN SHALL PROVIDE REGISTRATION CERTIFICATE UNDER RULE 14 4(X I) GFR 2017 TO QUOTE IN GEM. 10. SUPPLIER SHALL CONFIRM ARAI/ICAT CERTIFICATION. 11. SUPPLIER SHALL CONFIRM FREE ONE YEAR DIAGNOSTIC TROUBLING SHOOTING SUPPORT (LAPTOP/ONLINE)RELATED TO DEF/ENGINE DEFECTS AFTER WARRANTY PERIOD. 12. The supplier should have an authorized service centre in Odisha(preferable in Rourkela) to render tech nical services during commissioning, warranty and after sale technical/ spares requirement. PRICE VARIATION CLAUSE : FIRM TILL DELIVERY DELIVERY REQUIREMENT : WITHIN 3 MONTHS FROM THE DATE OF PLACEMENT OF ORDER. PAYMENT TERM:90 % AGAINST GARN & 10 % AFTER COMMISSIONING. PLACE OF INSPECTION : AT R.S.P STORE AFTER RECEIPT. INSPECTION AGENCY : JOINTLY BY INDENTOR OR HIS REPRESENTATIVE AND MGR(INSP)SAIL,RSP. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA 1. The bidder should be Original Equipment Manufacturer of Tyre Mounted Pay Loader or OEM’ s Authorized Dealer / Authorized Channel Partner / Authorized Agent. [The bidder other than OEM shall submit Authorization issued by OEM]. 2. The bidder should have successfully supplied and commissioned at least 1 number of TYRE PAY LOADER, 115HP (MIN.) ENGINE WITH 1.8 CU.M(MIN) BUCKET CAPACITY to any Central/State Govt Organizations/PSUs/Joint Venture Company Where at least one of the Partners shall be central or S tate Government Organization or PSU/ Public limited companies during last 07 years ending last d ay of the month previous to one in which NIT is invited.

The bidder shall submit following documentary evidence in support of the above: I. Copy of purchase order in the name of the bidder. II. Corresponding copy of commissioning and satisfactory performance(for a period not less than 1 2 months) for the quoted payloader model. .
